# Ge Zhang Academic Hub

Ge Zhang is a cardiovascular researcher focusing on artificial intelligence, multimodal clinical data, multi-omics, atherosclerosis and vascular biology, circadian cardiovascular biology, heart failure, translational biomarkers, and precision cardiovascular medicine.

- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3116-3246
